media.title: Hotel Comercial, Mexicali — historical postcard
media.description: Historical postcard view explicitly captioned Hotel Comercial in Mexicali, the hotel recorded as Kaper’s last permanent residence abroad in his 1 November 1935 immigration manifest.
media.altText: Sepia postcard view of the arcaded Hotel Comercial in Mexicali, with palm trees and a water tower beside the building.
media.publicCaption: Hotel Comercial in Mexicali, shown in an undated historical postcard. Kaper’s 1935 immigration manifest records this hotel as his last permanent residence abroad.

places.displayName: Commercial Hotel (formerly Hotel Aldrete), Madero at Azueta, Mexicali
places.authorizedName: Hotel Comercial (formerly Hotel Aldrete), Avenida Francisco I. Madero at Calle José Azueta, Mexicali, Baja California
places.publicNote: Kaper’s 1 November 1935 Calexico manifest records the Commercial Hotel in Mexicali as his last permanent residence abroad. Historical evidence identifies the Hotel Comercial as the renamed Hotel Aldrete on Avenida Francisco I. Madero, between Ayuntamiento and José Azueta, beside Parque Héroes de Chapultepec. The marker represents that documented site; 301 is the present-day parcel number, not a verified 1935 street number.
